home.heroSub: An interactive guide where you predict, run, watch it happen, understand why and break it on purpose. No videos, nothing to install.
howItems: Predict: before running, make a guess.
Run: type a command or use the buttons.
See: the scene shows what happens inside.
Why: the explanation at 3 levels, from beginner to expert.
Break it: get it wrong on purpose and find the limit.

real.label: Who answers
real.simNote: Toy model: hand-made numbers to show the mechanism.
real.download: This downloads {model} (~{size}). It stays cached in this browser for next time.
real.needsKey: Set up your API key to use a frontier model.

errors.needsDownload: First download the model in the "Who answers" panel.
errors.needsKey: Set up your key before running.
errors.unsupported: This device doesn’t support this mode. Switch back to "Simulated".
errors.webgpu: This device has no WebGPU, which the model needs. Use the "Your key" option or a recent desktop browser.
errors.download: The download failed. Check your connection and try again.
errors.blocked: The provider refused a direct browser call (CORS). Try another provider or an OpenAI-compatible one such as OpenRouter.
errors.auth: The provider rejected the key. Check you copied all of it and that it is active.
errors.quota: Your account hit a limit or ran out of credit. Check the provider’s dashboard.
errors.model: The provider didn’t accept the model or the request. Pick another model on the key page.

key.title: Your API key
key.intro: Use your own frontier model in the lessons that allow it. The call goes straight from your browser to the provider; Whyzzle has no server and never sees the key.
key.warn: Use a key just for this, with a low spending limit. Anyone with access to this browser can read the key.
key.remember: Remember on this device (otherwise it’s gone when the tab closes)
key.saved: Key saved. Go back to the lesson and choose "Your key".
key.forget: Delete the key from this device
